items.docs: Returns a personalised feed for the authenticated user ranked by followed users, followed instruments, prior engagement, and freshness. Ranking method is resolved via A/B experiment (Optimizely) and per-user overrides. Requires authentication — this feed is intrinsically personal.

params.name: badgesExperimentIsEnabled
